note: Captured once from published effect-dynamodb 1.39.0 on DynamoDB Local. Never regenerate it.
describes: Published effect-dynamodb@1.39.0 and @effect-dynamodb/schema@1.39.0 with effect@4.1.2. Per look-alike type, one table on DynamoSchema { name: keys, version: 1 } holding the entities Soft (sk [f], softDelete: true), Unique (unique byF: [f]), Indexed (gsi1 pk [f]), Retained (sk [f], versioned retain) and the aggregate Roots (pk [id, f], collection roots, root entityType Root), each with the model { id, f, note? }. Stages, each the table scanned and sorted by pk|sk: put (Soft a, Unique b, Indexed c, Retained d put; Roots e created with note one), softDeleted (Soft a deleted), restored (Soft a restored), updated (Unique b deleted; Retained d and Indexed c updated with note x; Roots e updated to note two). results holds each step's outcome.
